Native Legends Structures source reconstruction, DF 53.16 Windows x64

Sources are the two configured native-pe-images.json images. RVAs below are
reference/Steam; classic uses the matching owners in native-owners.tsv and
event-structure-relevance.tsv. The .asm files retain decoded source instructions,
including MSVC chained unwind extents and directly reachable leaf branch arms.
native-switches.tsv retains indexed targets; event-finite-operands.txt retains
all finite operands of the related native paragraph producers. Dynamic names,
RAW labels and world IDs are fields, not sentences or translation literals.

PAGE AND FOCUS
  Structure tab producer d4e240; corresponding classic d4b280.
  Reuse a tab when kind=8 and selected directory index matches tab+24.
  Otherwise find site via screen+258[index], then AB via screen+270[index].
  site.buildings=site+2b0; native ID lookup compares AB+8.
  Missing site/AB yields the native title "Unknown structure".
  Valid title = native language name + ', "' + translated-language name + '"'
                + ', ' + bare structure type. Title naming calls getName+10
  unconditionally; introduction naming separately checks has_name+72.
  Context is fully initialized: all focus IDs -1, flags=2; set context+28=site,
  context+38=AB, then describe(history,context,false,out) at d4e750.
  d4e75d appends the complete source string into tab+28 richbox.

DESCRIBE FOCUS SELECTOR (b8eeb0)
  Default unset. Successive present IDs overwrite earlier selections:
  context+20 collection -> kind13;
  context+38 AB -> kind25, site=context+28, subid=AB;
  otherwise context+28 site -> kind14;
  context+18 figure -> kind15;
  context+2c underground layer -> kind20;
  context+30 surface region -> kind21;
  context+34 artifact -> kind26;
  context+68 written content -> kind27;
  context+1c entity -> kind8 (highest priority).
  Focus dispatch tables index kind-8. All other introduction arms are retained
  in the complete describe source, including invalid/unset/default branches.

STRUCTURE INTRODUCTION (b8fc7a..b8fd45)
  Resolve site; resolve AB using context subid. Either missing => no intro.
  b8fcc0: AB(site,subid,prefer_name=true,flags=context.flags)
  append " was "
  b8fcec: AB(site,subid,prefer_name=false,flags=0)
  append " in "
  b8fd10: SITE(site,flags=context.flags)
  append ".  " at b8fd20
  confidence = BUILDING_CONFIDENCE(AB) at b8fd28
  append CONFIDENCE_TEXT(confidence) at b8fd35
  append "[B]" at b8fd45
  There is no present-tense/is alternative in this native introduction.

AB FIELD GRAMMAR (b94090)
  Missing site or missing AB => "an unknown building", without an AB link.
  If flags&2, open "[LPAGE:AB:" + site.id + ':' + AB.id + ']'.
  If prefer_name && getName+10 != null && language_name.has_name(+72):
      append translated-language name via a946e0; close link if opened; return.
  Otherwise read getType slot0 and choose the complete article-bearing term.
  For type outside signed-short 0..13 => "an unknown building".
  For known dungeon with subtype outside 0..2 => append no type text; the
  optional link still closes. A valid name bypasses this empty subtype branch.
  Base abstract_building vtable15e7be0 has getType=-1 and getName=null.
  Named classes except temple: getName returns this+b8 (native getter67170).
  Temple: getName returns this+c0 (native getter67550). Native subtitle/type
  remains "a temple" regardless temple deity/entity qualification.

TYPE SWITCH (formatter b943c0; bare title d4e820)
  0  mead_hall       "a mead hall"        / "mead hall"
  1  keep            "a keep"             / "keep"
  2  temple          "a temple"           / "temple"
  3  dark_tower      "a dark tower"       / "dark tower"
  4  market          "a market"           / "market"
  5  tomb            "a tomb"             / "tomb"
  6  dungeon         subtype switch below
  7  underworld_spire "an underworld spire" / "underworld spire"
  8  inn_tavern      "a tavern"           / "tavern"
  9  library         "a library"          / "library"
  10 counting_house  "a counting house"   / "counting house"
  11 guildhall       "a guildhall"        / "guildhall"
  12 tower           "a tower"            / "tower"
  13 hospital        "a hospital"         / "hospital"
  dungeon subtype WORD AB+130:
    0 "a dungeon" / "dungeon"
    1 "the sewers" / "sewers"
    2 "the catacombs" / "catacombs"
    default empty type content; title keeps its name and preceding comma.
  Title unsupported type adds no bare type; lookup failure is Unknown structure.
  Native underworld article is "an"; article-bearing fields are indivisible.

CONFIDENCE (b95170 and b95720 plus leaf branch arms)
  Count related native events whose information flags contain bit1. Relevance
  queries use event slot98 with AB.site_id(+98) and AB.id(+8).
  count >=100 ->5; >=50 ->3; >=10 ->4; >=5 ->2; >=1 ->1; else0.
  0/default: append no qualifier.
  1: "A few issues still trouble scholars, but the picture is fairly clear.  "
  2: "Many facts are still unclear to historians.  "
  3: "It is still shrouded in mystery.  "
  4: "Its nature is still an intriguing puzzle to the learned.  "
  5: "Only the barest fragments of this amazing story have been uncovered.  It is one of the great untold tales of our times.  "

STRUCTURE EVENT SELECTION (b9001b..b90089)
  Skip event with nonempty event.information vector whose first flags have bit1.
  Query event virtual slot98 (isRelatedToSiteStructure) with selected site and AB.
  When true, call event slotd0/getSentence(out,context,true,false) at b90072.
  Append one independent "[B]" after that complete event at b90089.
  Ordinary relationship and battle-membership insertion blocks require their
  own non-structure focus and cannot supply extra prose in Structures kind25.
  introduction_only=true skips the entire event loop.
  Every concrete history event was followed through its actual RTTI vtable.
  108 classes inherit false slot67050; 25 override slot98. Of those 25,
  agreement_formed75 and agreement_concluded77 have lookup-only predicate
  c19420 that always returns false at c1949f; these cannot enter Structures.
  The other 23 contain a true-capable path. All failure arms return false.

TRUE-CAPABLE PREDICATES (site s, abstract building b; offsets from event)
  19 artifact_lost: event+2c=s and +30 valid profile ID; resolve site.profiles
     (+2d0); require profile.type(+4)=0 and profile.abstract_building_id(+8)=b.
  20 artifact_found: same property lookup with event site+34/profile+38.
  21 artifact_recovered,74 artifact_stored,97 hf_act_on_artifact:
     event+34=s && event+38=b. Predicate1016c0.
  27 entity_created,28 entity_action,36 entity_razed_building,
  54 hf_razed_building,114 gamble:
     event+2c=s && event+30=b. Predicate5c2010.
  30 created_building,68 change_hf_body_state,69 hf_act_on_building:
     event+30=s && event+34=b. Predicate5c15e0.
  31 replaced_building: event+30=s && (event+34=b || event+38=b).
     Both old and new buildings may own this event. Predicate8f3e30.
  32 add_hf_site_link,33 remove_hf_site_link,118 modified_building:
     event+28=s && event+2c=b. Predicate5c25f0.
  53 item_stolen: event+40=s && event+44=b. Predicate103f00.
  100 artifact_copied: (source site+34=s && source AB+3c=b) OR
     (destination site+38=s && destination AB+40=b). Predicate8f4d70.
  105 hist_figure_simple_action: event+48=s && event+4c=b. Predicate1023e0.
  108 tactical_situation: event+3c=s && event+40=b. Predicate104e40.
  109 squad_vs_squad: event+98=s && event+9c=b. Predicate105010.
  119 building_profile_acquired: event site+28 and profile+2c valid; resolve
     site.profiles(+2d0), require profile.type=0, event site=s, profile.AB=b.

PARAGRAPH PRODUCERS
  Every producer keeps the native date prefix and dynamic participant fields.
  event-finite-operands.txt gives every complete prose operand at its source
  instruction; native-literals.tsv also preserves separators and inline stores.
  The two ASM sources preserve conditional/default arms and child calls.
  The following is the producer map and its alternatives, not rendered examples.

  19 artifact_lost b8a8c0: artifact was lost; optional property+site or site only.
  20 artifact_found b8ada0: artifact was found; optional property+site/site and
     optional finder introduced with "by ".
  21 artifact_recovered b8b6b0: artifact was recovered by actor; optional AB/site
     introduced with "from ", with additional site/location arms.
  27 entity_created b68020: optional creator; entity formed; AB then site.
  28 entity_action b68180: movement/criminal-organization actions selected by enum;
     optional actor/entity/location; native default can omit the finite action.
  30 created_building b69280: actor entity; "constructed ","rebuilt ", or
     "thrust a spire of slade up from the underworld, naming it "; optional
     ", and established a gateway between worlds"; AB/site fields retained.
  31 replaced_building b69450: actor; old building then replacement and site;
     both structure fields use native named/type fallback independently.
  32 add_hf_site_link b77ed0: working/ruling/hanging out/residence/lair/imprisonment;
     native residence distinguishes bare location and building; "of " entity
     and "in " site qualifiers. Every finite link kind/default retained.
  33 remove_hf_site_link b780b0: stopped working/ruling/hanging out, moved out,
     escaped; same building/entity/site qualification distinction.
  36 entity_razed_building b69590: entity razed building in site.
  53 item_stolen b8b080..b8b3..: artifact or article+item; "was stolen", "was
     recovered", "was looted", "was confiscated" action arms; "from "+AB/site
     or region/layer; "by "+actor; optional "and brought to "+destination.
  54 hf_razed_building b69670: figure razed AB; site qualifier only when both
     site and building valid, independently from missing subject fields.
  68 change_hf_body_state b76120: "arose from", "was discarded in", "was buried
     in", "was entombed in"; optional "within "+AB and site/layer/region/wilds.
  69 hf_act_on_building b69760: action0 "profaned",1 "disturbed",
     2 "prayed inside"; default inserts no verb. Every case uses
     prefer_name=true for AB, followed by " in "+site+'.'.
  74 artifact_stored b87ad0: artifact "was stored"; optional AB and site clauses,
     optional actor introduced with "by ".
  75 agreement_formed 2aaf70,77 agreement_concluded b81f00: source bodies retained
     because they override predicate slot98; the actual predicate is always false.
  97 hf_act_on_artifact b698b0: actor "asked about" or "viewed" artifact;
     unknown action leaves verb empty; optional AB/site clause.
  100 artifact_copied b89fc0: actor "acquired a copy of " or "made a copy of the
     original "+artifact; "from "+source; "in "/"of "+site; optional
     ", keeping it within "+destination AB+" in "+destination site.
  105 hist_figure_simple_action b6dcb0..b6e1dc: participants1..4 with list rules;
     failed diplomatic meeting reasons, experiments, carousing, equipment purchase
     with quality0..5/default; AB/site, region, layer, unknown-lands location arms.
  108 tactical_situation b6c4a0..b6cb78: commander/force variants; matched,
     cunning/superior/outwitted/outmaneuvered plans, actor tactical quality and
     attacker/defender positional advantage; initial/shifted positions and place.
  109 squad_vs_squad b6cd90: commander/force names; leadership qualifications;
     battle circumstances selected by enums; location AB/site/region/layer/default.
  114 gamble b84e70: "made a fortune", "did well", "lost a fortune", "did
     poorly", "broke even" followed by "gambling"; AB/site clauses; optionally
     "and went further into debt" or "and went into debt".
  118 modified_building b7af80: "had a feast hall added to", "had a gated
     courtyard added to", "had the fortifications improved of", "had a dungeon
     constructed within"; structure/site qualifiers and native empty default.
  119 building_profile_acquired b7b230: profile lookup subtype0/other; actor
     "rebuilt", "inherited", "purchased"; profile/site name and optional
     "formerly owned by "+previous entity or figure.

RENDER SOURCE
  Reference legends renderer d3e8d0; classic d3b910. Full decoded renderer retained.
  Reference graphical tabs use caption row r15+4, tab skins row4/5, draw flags
  8/16. Header pinned title is independent from the tab controls.
  Active tab richbox layout d43418; transformed token draw d435e4. Native token
  coordinate+28/+2c supplies x/y, view scroll is subtracted, and top offset added.
  intro and events are separate native [B] paragraphs, not one source sentence.
